source.citation: Sidek et al. (2016) Crustal thickness beneath North Borneo from receiver function analysis. Bull. Geol. Soc. Malaysia 62, 55-63; Madon et al. (2025) Gravity and crustal structure of Sabah.

processing_lineage.method: P-to-S receiver function H-kappa stacking (Zhu & Kanamori 2000)

predictions.kill_condition: Moho < 28 km or Moho > 38 km without positive gravity anomaly

kill_criteria: Moho > 40 km under Crocker axis without mantle downwelling signature
Absence of flexural forebulge in Dangerous Grounds outer-rise

predictions.kill_condition: Moho <= 35.0 km under Crocker axis kills localized lithospheric drip hypothesis

kill_criteria: Moho <= 35 km under Crocker axis (provenance: Cottam 2010 / Sidek 2016)
Lack of anomalous high-velocity mantle blob in upper 150 km tomographic slice

epistemic_split.observed: 32.8 km Moho depth at station KMY_BROADBAND
epistemic_split.derived: Airy root calculation under T0=30.0 km reference
epistemic_split.interpreted: Whether crustal thickness represents underthrust Dangerous Grounds (Model A) vs localized mantle lithosphere drip (Model D)
epistemic_split.assumed: Isostatic equilibrium, crust density 2800.0 kg/m³, mantle density 3300.0 kg/m³
epistemic_split.contradicted: Deep (>42 km) localized lithospheric downwelling directly beneath Crocker axis
epistemic_split.missing: Receiver-function station profile directly under Kinabalu granite summit (0-15 km offset)

MODEL-A-UNDERTHRUST.reason: Observed 32.8 km ± 2.5 falls inside predicted range [30.0, 35.0]

MODEL-D-DRIP.reason: Observed 32.8 ± 2.5 completely outside predicted range [42.0, 55.0]. Residual: 9.20 km

outcome_consequence.on_model_1_win: Maintain underthrust passive margin interpretation. Re-evaluate flexural forebulge in offshore MC3D.
outcome_consequence.on_model_2_win: Delamination confirmed. Shift exploration focus to deep thermal pulse and late-stage trap breach.
outcome_consequence.on_indeterminate: Acquire dense teleseismic broadband array across Crocker axis before drilling deep targets.
